source.title: 737-600/-700/-800/-900 Flight Crew Operations Manual
source.qualification: The cover says this material is provided solely as guidance on the layout and structure of a typical aircraft manual, has not been approved by any aviation administration, and must not be used for operation, use or maintenance of an aircraft.
source.purposeHere: source-separated engineering diagnostics, not an operational performance authority or automatic calibration target

applicability.aircraftConfigurationLimit: No registration-specific match, auxiliary-tank configuration or exact installed-power match to the current aircraft definition has been established.
applicability.wingletStatus: selected header is 737-800 without W; no explicit winglet applicability statement established

conditions.distance: still-air equivalent air distance, not uncorrected ground distance
conditions.fuelScope: whole trip including climb, cruise and descent; not a phase-only table
conditions.bleeds: not separately specified in selected PD enroute text

tripReference.referenceMassInference: The zero-adjustment column identifies the reference landing mass; it is an inference from this table, not a separately printed caption.

tripFuelAdjustment.operation: Add fuelAdjustmentKg to referenceFuelKg for the planned landing mass; values are not replacement total fuel.

conditions.fuelScope: whole trip including climb, cruise and descent
conditions.altitude: use the altitude printed for each distance and landing mass; it is not common to every cell

conditions.speedSchedule: FMC holding: higher of maximum-endurance speed and flaps-up maneuvering speed
conditions.temperature: not separately specified on holding page
conditions.straightLevelInstruction: Reduce printed table values by 5%, per the explanatory text; no adjustment applied to these stored rows.

conditions.speedSchedule: FMC holding: higher of maximum-endurance speed and flaps-up maneuvering speed
conditions.temperature: not separately specified on holding page
conditions.racetrackAllowanceNote: PI.31.8 says additional fuel; PD.31.5 specifies 5%. The two printed flow tables have independent rounding.

conditions.approachConfiguration: gear down and landing flaps at outer marker
conditions.massDependence: Published time and fuel columns are common to all four landing masses; only distance has mass columns.

conditions.temperatureInput: TAT, not OAT or ISA deviation

maxClimbN1.bleedCorrectionUnit: N1 percentage points, not thrust percent or fuel-flow percent
maxClimbN1.limitation: This is a rotational-speed setting table; it does not provide climb fuel, time, distance, mass flow or shaft power.

conditions.scope: Printed in engine-inoperative text; all-engine PI.37.7 explicitly refers to this same table.

apuIncrement.limitation: Not a measurement of engine shaft-power extraction or a normal air-conditioning bleed penalty.

scopedCriticalFuelCorrections.scope: critical diversion reserve scenario only; not a normal cruise bleed correction
critical diversion reserve scenario only; not a normal cruise bleed correction

coverageLimits.separateNormalClimbFuelTimeDistance: not identified; integrated trip tables cannot uniquely separate climb fuel
coverageLimits.fixedMachCruiseFuelFlow: not identified in the selected normal-flight data; the trip cruise profile is LRC
coverageLimits.shaftPowerExtractionKw: no numerical mission shaft-load schedule identified
coverageLimits.normalAirConditioningBleedFuelPenaltyPct: no isolated numerical normal-cruise penalty identified

verification.method: Hash-pinned vector text, strict axes and cell counts; visual review of headers, units, layout, blank regions and numerical anchors. No OCR, interpolation, missing-cell fill or calibration.
